meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,agent 容器里的每次 Bash 调用都会经过 rtk 代理,git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令的 token 消耗可降低 60–90%,不需要在 CLAUDE.md 里写指令。
howto.when: 安装该技能时给指定 agent group 装上 rtk:宿主机装二进制、只读挂载进容器、在 settings.json 写入 PreToolUse 钩子。之后容器里跑 git、cargo、pytest 等命令时自动被拦截。

say.text: 跑一下 git status,看看 rtk 有没有拦截
say.note: rtk 会静默拦截该命令。

say.text: 执行 rtk gain 看节省了多少 token
say.note: 输出 token 节省统计。

howto.what_en: Once installed, every Bash call in the agent container is routed through the rtk proxy, cutting token use on dev commands like git, cargo and pytest by 60–90% — no CLAUDE.md instructions needed.
howto.when_en: When installing rtk for an agent group: rtk is installed on the host, mounted into the container, and a PreToolUse hook routes every Bash call through it, so git, cargo, pytest are intercepted.

say_en.text: Install rtk for this agent group and add the PreToolUse hook
say_en.note: Installs rtk, mounts it, writes the hook.

say_en.text: Run git status to check whether rtk intercepts it
Run rtk gain to see the token savings
